title: VtM5e Tools
description: Loader/bundle for the VtM5e Tools suite - a set of Vampire the Masquerade 5e modules for the wod5e system: a character sheet reskin, chat card reskin, a GM automation layer (damage, opposed rolls, weapon/armor conditions), a step-by-step character creation wizard, an XP spending shop, a coterie party sheet, and standalone Clan/Discipline/Path/Predator Type/Merit-Flaw/Loresheet/Equipment compendiums. Installing this module pulls in the rest as dependencies; disable any piece you don't want (e.g. swap in a different character sheet, or turn off the automation layer) from Manage Modules.
